spellbook.finance/limitations: Stored observations are historical facts. A read cursor grants no writer authority and does not discover more listings.

description: Read bounded stored pages of eBay enrollment identities, observed baselines, absolute bounds and exclusions. Call after spellbook_ebay_price_limit_enrollment_get. Follow nextCursor until null to inspect all stored pages; read the header again for overall completion.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the preceding stored-page response. Omit for the first page.

enrollmentId.description: Enrollment ID returned by preparation. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_ebay_price_limit_enrollment_pages
